presentationBindings.backupItemToConfirm: Phone and Tablet backup-item prototype hits open the retained Confirm overlay with a 0.15s dissolve.
presentationBindings.confirmToLoading: FigmaRestoreBackupOverlay renders the reviewed 150ms dissolve only after the existing Core restore request has moved to restoring.
presentationBindings.loadingToComplete: The Figma demonstration 1.2s timeout is never used as a business completion signal. Complete appears only after the existing Core-owned restore-result plus success terminal.
presentationBindings.completeClose: The retained Complete toast auto-closes after the reviewed 1.5s presentation duration, guarded by a live route/status/sequence re-check.

restoreOverlayPrototypeBackport.ownership: Presentation-only. Core/Host retains backup validity, atomic apply, success, failure, and durable route ownership.
restoreOverlayPrototypeBackport.staleSafety: A newer flow, cancel, route leave, or an out-of-date Complete timer cannot close a later transaction.
restoreOverlayPrototypeBackport.reducedMotionBoundary: The component commits directly to Loading when reader.reducedMotion is true; this is local prototype handling only and does not claim global F3 completion.

motion.policy: The direct Figma prototype presentation above is not F3. No independently frozen F3 actor timeline, global interrupt/cleanup contract, or global reduced-motion contract is claimed by this reconciliation.

currentLocalReconciliation.evidencePolicy: This records current source hierarchy and local implementation boundaries only. It writes no Figma state, changes no historical record, and contains no fabricated revision or commit reference.
